title: Capstone Architecture
description: Design the enterprise AI knowledge assistant system architecture.

data.text: Design the complete system architecture for the enterprise AI knowledge assistant, including backend, frontend, data layer, AI services, and infrastructure.

data.title: Key Takeaways
points: Plan data flow and integration points
data.takeaway: A well-designed architecture is the foundation of a successful project. Document decisions and plan for scalability from the start.
